items.heading: Shopska Salad
details: Key ingredients: tomato, cucumber, onion, sirene cheese, peppers
Dice tomato, cucumber, onion and roasted peppers.
Toss the vegetables with a little oil and vinegar.
Mound the salad onto plates.
Grate sirene cheese generously over the top before serving.

items.heading: Banitsa
details: Key ingredients: phyllo dough, eggs, sirene cheese, yogurt, butter
Whisk eggs with crumbled sirene cheese and yogurt.
Layer buttered phyllo sheets in a round pan, drizzling the egg mixture between layers.
Crumple additional sheets loosely on top for texture.
Bake until puffed, golden and set in the center.
